rows.disposition_job: R1-SNAP (receipt gate landed 2026-08-25; the attestation's honesty is the ledgered residual)
rows.guard_notes: Init snapshot restore (associated fn, crates/clean-kernel/src/env/snapshot.rs; matched in Environment:: form only). 2026-08-25 (R1-SNAP): the 'caller is responsible for only snapshotting a re-verified env' gap is closed with the crystal's lineage pattern — save_snapshot seals the caller's SnapshotAttestation (what was re-verified, how much, when) into a SnapshotReceipt whose env_content_sha256 the KERNEL computes over the exact serialized env bytes written (content-derived; no timestamp enters the binding), and load_snapshot under SnapshotReceiptPolicy::RequireReceipt (the only production policy; sole prod caller preload_init_with_snapshot attests only after its fail==0 typecheck_constants_full re-verify) REFUSES a snapshot whose receipt is absent or does not bind (SNAPSHOT_VERSION bumped 1->2; v1 snapshots are a decode/version cache miss, fail safe). THE GUARD (ledgered here): SnapshotReceiptPolicy::AcceptUnreceipted is the explicit opt-out — it still restores, but returns the loud LoadedUnreceipted outcome carrying the violation, has ZERO production callers, and any first production use must show up in this row. Adversarial pins: kernel snapshot.rs tests (receipt-less refuses; caller-forged receipt stripped at save; spliced receipt/env-bytes refuses with ContentMismatch; opt-out loads AND reports) + clean-olean test_receiptless_snapshot_is_refused_not_reused (warm path refuses, receipted control twin restores). Residual trust (why still P, not closed): the receipt binds the attestation to content — it cannot make the attestation TRUE; the verifying run's honesty is the remaining assumption, now named and content-pinned instead of ambient.

rows.guard_notes: The R1-STUB checked tier replacing axiom-stub-upgrade (registration.rs): per record, the stub must EXIST, the record passes validate_constant_info_structural, the incoming type must kernel-match the stub's type (arity + positional alpha-insensitive equality, is_def_eq fallback — the upgrade can never change a constant's stated type), and the incoming VALUE must check_type against it via the exact add_decl machinery. A failing record REFUSES fail-closed: the stub stays, the (name, EnvError) is returned for loud accounting (olean lanes record it in summary.skipped_constants), and nothing ever registers unchecked. Residual trust (why watched, classification S not closed): the G4 UnknownConst tolerance — a value with an unresolved forward/external reference is admitted after the structural+type-anchor tiers only, because the demand-load lane assembles closures incrementally; stamp stays conservative (Unchecked, the same stamp the G4 lane mints) so no verdict over-claims. Perf: at fixture scale (clean-olean --lib, 485 tests) the per-value check_type cost is not measurable (7.5 s suite, unchanged order); no opt-out exists — the checked path is unconditionally on.
